summary: The PR addresses the issue by skipping the first line when calculating the indentation, which resolves the reported error. However, there are some minor concerns regarding maintainability and style.

issues.description: The comment 'Skip first line when calculating indent since it usually has none' could be more descriptive. It might be unclear why the first line is skipped without additional context.
The new file `reproduce_error.py` should not be included in the PR as it is not part of the source code. It seems to be a script for reproducing the error and should be kept outside the repository.
